messages.content: Write a realistic SMS conversation, 4 to 8 short texts, between a patient in rural North Dakota with hypertension or type 2 diabetes and Northline Care's weekly check-in agent. Situation: routine weekly check-in, reading logged, nothing else. Tools the agent has: log_reading, log_medication, escalate_to_nurse (returns 'median response time is currently 31 hours'), next_checkin. It cannot do refills, insurance, transport, diet advice, device support, or reply to loneliness beyond kindness; it says so plainly. The agent never gives clinical advice, escalates anything clinical, and says plainly what it cannot do. Patient id pt-1008. Vary tone and wording; conversation number 31. tools_used lists the tools the agent would call; escalated is true if escalate_to_nurse is among them.

PATIENT: "Weekly check. Got 162/98 for my BP this morning."

AGENT: "Got that logged, thanks. Everything going okay otherwise?"

PATIENT: "Yeah mostly. My BP meds are running low though - can you get me a refill?"

AGENT: "I can't process refills, but your pharmacy or doctor's office can do that fast. Anything concern you about that BP reading?"

PATIENT: "No, I'm feeling fine today."

AGENT: "That's good to hear. Next check-in is Friday. Take care!"

theme: routine weekly check-in, reading logged, nothing else
